solutionSql:
SELECT origin_id,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN destination_id = 1 THEN distance_km END), 0)::integer AS km_to_warehouse_1,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN destination_id = 2 THEN distance_km END), 0)::integer AS km_to_warehouse_2
FROM routes
GROUP BY origin_id
ORDER BY origin_id;

ambiguities.phrase: A warehouse with no route to warehouse 1 shows zero there, not blank.
ambiguities.readingChosen: Zero instead of NULL applies to both destination columns (warehouse 1 and warehouse 2).
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Only km_to_warehouse_1 is coalesced to zero; km_to_warehouse_2 may stay NULL when there is no route to warehouse 2.

ambiguities.readingChosen: SUM results (bigint) are cast to integer to match the stated column types.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Leave SUM as bigint; values are identical, only the declared type differs.

notes: Conditional aggregation with SUM(CASE ...) grouped by origin_id over routes only, so only originating warehouses appear. Multiple routes on the same origin-destination pair are summed (origin 1 has two routes to warehouse 2: 125+108=233). Routes to other destinations contribute zero to both columns.
